title: Chhaya cell collection
description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection returned by GET /cells and stored as features/cells.geojson. One feature per H3 cell. This file is the shared contract between pipeline/, api/ and web/. Change it only after telling the other two.

polygon.description: H3 cell boundary as a GeoJSON Polygon in WGS84, [longitude, latitude], closed ring.

h3.description: H3 cell index as a lowercase hex string. The pipeline fixes the resolution (suggested: 8).

ndvi.description: Median Sentinel-2 NDVI over the cell. Higher means greener.

lst_c.description: Land surface temperature in degrees Celsius. null when the pipeline ships the NDVI-only fallback.

population.description: Estimated people living in the cell (WorldPop aggregate).

built_frac.description: Fraction of the cell covered by buildings or impervious surface.

dust_idx.description: Bare-soil-near-roads index. Exposure proxy, not measured dust.

school_count.description: Number of schools inside the cell (OSM).

ward.description: Ward name or number the cell centre falls in. Use 'unknown' when it cannot be assigned.

priority.description: Default combined priority score (1 = plant here first). The web app may reweight client-side.
